For every age, every stage

One bookshop, every reader in the family. We're stocking shelves for each stage of a reading life — so the book you pick fits the reader it's for, whether that's a first bedtime story or a brand-new chapter of your own.

Ages 0–8

Little readers

Picture books and read-aloud stories for laps, prams, and bedtimes — rhythm, repetition, big feelings, and first words, written to be read together, one more time than planned.

Ages 9–12

Growing readers

Chapter books and adventures for readers finding their own way through a story — braver journeys, funnier trouble, and books they'll want to finish all by themselves.

Teens & YA

Young adult readers

Fiction and coming-of-age stories for teenagers and young adults — first loves, big questions, and worlds that take a growing reader seriously.

Adults

Grown-up readers

Fiction, non-fiction, and practical guides for adult life — home, family, wellbeing, and life's next chapters. Proof that a good book isn't something you grow out of.

For readers: how we're building the store

Whether you're choosing a book for a child, a teenager, or yourself, here's what we're holding every FlutterFoot shelf to while we build it.

  • Something for everyone

    Children's picture books sit happily alongside adult fiction and practical guides — because reading is a whole-life habit, and a family bookshop should stock the whole of it.

  • Honest labels, no surprises

    When books launch, every book page will carry its genre, who it's for — age range for younger readers, a plain-English note for everyone else — plus format and page count. No guessing.

  • Peek before you buy

    Sample pages and first chapters are part of the plan for every title, so you can hear a book's voice — read-aloud rhythm for little ones, opening chapters for grown-ups — before you spend a penny.

  • Extras for every kind of reader

    Free printables and read-together questions for families, and reading guides and checklists to go with our grown-up titles — starting with the free sheet on this page, no purchase needed.

A free family printable, while you wait

From our children's corner: a sample FlutterFoot activity sheet — colour in the little fox, solve the maze, join the stars, and draw what he finds at the end of the path. Yours to keep, books or no books.

About FlutterFoot Books

FlutterFoot Books is a general bookstore for all ages and genres. Our name celebrates the little kid inside all of us — not because our books are only for children, but because the best reading never loses its wonder, whether you're four, fourteen, forty, or eighty. Our first books are in the works now — Coming Soon — across the shelves above: children's and picture books, fiction, mystery and adventure, non-fiction, home and lifestyle, wellbeing, and young adult stories. When the first titles are ready, Readers Club members will hear about them first — titles, covers, and all.
